# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Parent: cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, val 0.360). Reward is graded on FINAL DB STATE, not exact
call args (confirmed: task 8 trial5 got reward 1.0 with a book_reservation whose args
were an [MISS] in action_checks — the resulting DB state matched gold). So the lever is
"end DB state correct", which for several tasks means acting on the RIGHT reservation.

## Ranked issue list (by leverage = #tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Wrong reservation / flight located** | 22 (0.00×10), 17 (0.40), 8 (0.20) | user doesn't give the reservation id (or names a past flight by route/date); agent GUESSES an id and acts on the wrong reservation (task 22 always picks UM3OG5 = Seattle→Dallas instead of FQ8APE = Newark→Chicago; task 8 books a different flight than the May-10 one). No tool enumerates a user's reservations by route. | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW code tool `list_user_reservations` + prompt procedure |
| 2 | Insurance-covered cancel misread | 19 (0.50) | reservation has insurance=yes and user says they "feel unwell" (a health reason = covered), but the agent labels it "change of plan → not covered" and transfers instead of cancelling. | KNOWLEDGE | additive prompt clarification of what health/weather reasons cover |
| 3 | Cabin-downgrade refund dispute | 11 (0.60) | dialogue loops on refund-method dispute → agent transfers/cancels instead of downgrading. | dialogue-flaky | SKIPPED (no safe code lever) |
| 4 | Business-upgrade overstep vs budget | 12 (0.20) | agent upgrades cabin to business when the computed cost ($1200) exceeds the user's stated $650 budget (gold does bags only). | dialogue/compute | SKIPPED (bag count already fixed by iter-1 recompute; overstep is dialogue) |
| 5 | Multi-book payment split ordering | 23 (0.40) | gold splits payment cert→giftcards→creditcard fully; agent skips a gift card → payment_history mismatch. | — | SKIPPED (auto-allocation is a known regression risk) |
| 6 | Passenger-name confirm-turn variance | 40 (0.20) | user sends "yes" + `###STOP###` in one turn; episode ends before the (correct) tool call fires. | infra noise | SKIPPED (simulator variance, not code) |
| 7 | Wrong payment-card match / refuse-all | 37 (0.50) | agent picks wrong credit card ("ending 7334") or transfers all 3 asks instead of doing the one legal upgrade. | dialogue/match | SKIPPED (matching is agent's job; iter-1 cancel guard already blocks the 2 illegal cancels) |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **NEW code-bearing tool** (capability-gap closer) | tools.py `list_user_reservations` | loops over `user.reservations`, returns per-reservation dict {id, origin/destination as `IATA (City)`, flight_type, cabin, status, created_at, insurance, passengers, flights[flight_number,date,origin,dest]}. Lets the agent match a trip by city/date to the right id instead of guessing. General for ANY locate-by-route task. | BOUNDED — new READ tool; reads never change graded DB state. Never crashes (tested on all users). Passing tasks with an explicit id need not call it. |
| 1 | in-body helper | tools.py `_IATA_TO_CITY` + `_city_label` | mirrors `list_all_airports` (single source) so reservations show city names for matching. | none (pure data) |
| 1 | prompt procedure + 2 worked examples | policy.md new "## Locating a reservation" + strengthened Modify/Cancel locate lines | ordered steps: get user id → call `list_user_reservations` → pick the reservation whose cities/dates match → act only on it; note EWR/JFK/LGA = New York. | additive knowledge for the no-id case; no permission/decision rule changed |
| 2 | additive prompt knowledge | policy.md Cancel-flight insurance bullet | states health (feeling unwell/ill/injured) and weather reasons ARE insurance-covered; change of plan is NOT. | additive clarification; does NOT loosen the refuse rule (change-of-plan still not covered), so no passing refuse-task flips |

## Verify-the-fix (per edit)
- `list_user_reservations` EXPOSED (get_tools → 15 tools, schema builds). omar_rossi_1241 → only FQ8APE has destination "ORD (Chicago)" ⇒ task 17/22 now locatable. sophia_silva_7557 → the sole 2024-05-10 "Chicago→Philadelphia" leg is HAT271 (res WUNA5K) ⇒ task 8's "same flight" now findable. Ran over EVERY user in the DB: 0 errors (blast-radius safe).
- cancel guard UNCHANGED and re-verified: Z7GOZK (insurance) → ALLOWED (task 19 gold cancel not blocked); IFOYYZ (no condition) → BLOCKED (task 37 illegal cancel still refused).
- Module imports cleanly under the tau2 venv; return annotation `list` serializes via env `to_json_str` (list→dict→json.dumps path).
- Insurance prose: the missing fact ("feeling unwell = health = covered") is now stated, general, unambiguous, and does not grant a new permission for uncovered reasons.

## Process & features used
- Serial (no subagents): the decisive signal was in the trajectories' embedded gold `action_checks` + the tau2 `tasks.json` instructions + the real `db.json`; I read them directly and verified the new tool against the live DB in the tau2 venv. A 2-file edit did not warrant worktree fan-out.
- Read prior_iterations/cand_0001 (PROCESS + diff) — built ON its guards (kept payment/baggage/cancel/dob code untouched); its open cluster ("wrong-reservation reasoning, tasks 17/22 — no safe code guard, only prose") is exactly what this iteration cracks with a tool instead of more prose.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- iter-1: single-payment amount auto-fill, payment/passenger dict normalization, `nonfree_baggages` recompute (book + update_baggages), 2-layer cancel eligibility guard, enriched actionable errors.
- iter-2: `list_user_reservations` + the "Locating a reservation" procedure — the locate-by-route capability.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 11 (refund dispute), 40 (confirm-turn `###STOP###` variance), 37 (wrong-card match / refuse-all): dialogue/simulator-driven, no safe general code lever.
- 12 business-upgrade overstep & 23 payment-split ordering: would need per-task budget/allocation knowledge; auto-allocation is a flagged regression risk. Left for a successor (a compute helper that reports the split cert→gift→credit could help 23 without writing).
